answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses for shadow work**, the strongest options in the results are **Jung Platform’s “Encounters with the Shadow,” ManTalks’ “Shadow Course,” Awake Academy’s “Embracing the Shadow,” and Catherine Liggett’s live Shadow Work course** because they emphasize structured practice, Jungian framing, or guided facilitation.[2][7][17][6]

For **spiritual practice**, the most relevant courses in your results are the ones that explicitly connect shadow integration to **meditation, prayers, journaling, and transformation**, especially the **Udemy “Shadow Work Course and Workbook”** and **ManTalks’ “Shadow Course.”**[16][19]

A practical shortlist:

- **Jung Platform — “Encounters with the Shadow”**: Best if you want a more classical **Jungian** introduction to shadow work and psychological depth.[2][7]
- **ManTalks — “Shadow Course”**: Best if you want an **8-week guided process** with a spiritual/self-development angle.[19]
- **Awake Academy — “Embracing The Shadow” with Charlie Morley**: Best if you want a course positioned as highly **transformative** and focused on personal growth.[17]
- **Catherine Liggett — Shadow Work 101**: Best if you prefer a **live 5-week Zoom course** with practical techniques.[6]
- **Udemy — “Shadow Work Course and Workbook”**: Best if you want a self-paced course that includes **meditations, prayers, and practices** for spiritual transformation.[16]

If you want a simpler way to choose:

| If you want... | Best pick |
|---|---|
| Jungian theory and depth | Jung Platform “Encounters with the Shadow”[2][7] |
| Guided multi-week process | ManTalks “Shadow Course”[19] |
| Spiritual/self-transformation focus | Udemy “Shadow Work Course and Workbook”[16] |
| Live instruction and interaction | Catherine Liggett Shadow Work 101[6] |
| A highly reviewed transformational style course | Awake Academy “Embracing The Shadow”[17] |

Two cautions: many of these are **self-development courses**, not licensed psychotherapy, and the results you gave do not provide enough independent quality data to verify which is objectively “best” in terms of outcomes or instructor credentials.[1][3][4][16][19] If you want, I can turn this into a **ranked list by budget, depth, or spiritual orientation**.
